comment: The controls for level zero. Every rule lives in spec/config/styles, one file each: VoiceVale for the rules Vale holds, VoiceJudged for the rules a model holds.

log.comment: The level this box writes at. info writes everything, warn writes a refusal and a fault, error writes a fault. A level nobody names reads as info.

judge.comment: Switch the model off where it costs more than it earns. The mechanical rules ignore this.
